topic: Someone discovers their friend has been lying about their job
text: I remember the day I told you about my job, the way the sunlight danced through the old oak tree, casting golden shadows on my face. I recall how I painted the picture, how I wanted you to see me as more than I am. Now, with the truth out, I find myself stepping back, watching the space between us grow. I hope you can see, beyond the lies, there was always a wish to share something real with you, something that felt right. Maybe we can find our way back to that place, where the light still reaches us both.
